about: The first licensed T-shirt (wave 5, Paul's decision 13): BlenderKit's Plain T-shirt (CC0) through the intake, graded and draped onto the realistic body by cloth simulation (wave 5 stage 3, refinement/wave5/fit-drape.md), refined by refine.py. A draft until the lead's review and Paul's sign-off. The hand-back is docs/development/character-studio/refinement/wave5/tee-licensed.md.

item.label: Crew-neck T-shirt (licensed)
item.about: A short-sleeved cotton jersey T-shirt with a rib crew neck and turned hems, made from a CC0 licensed base.

source.author: Introspective Mnisi
source.evidence: The asset's page, https://www.blendkit.com/asset-gallery-detail/cd6d0347-484a-426c-9c72-9b8c117ef500/ (it redirects to .../126dea9d-bcb8-4edb-a688-b996b4779f84/, the asset's base ID), retrieved 2026-11-18, gives 'Plain T-Shirt', 'license: Creative commons zero', the author 'Introspective Mnisi', 'published 17 Sep 2026' and 'Plain, game ready, T-shirt with unwrapped UV texture and normal map'. Saved as retrieved: docs/development/character-studio/refinement/wave5/tee-licensed/evidence/asset-page-2026-11-18.html (SHA-256 4fd43b0c4ea80d6d00cf895ec2af3dd7a6b15dc49fbf1feb7083950fb438bef2). BlenderKit's API record of the asset (search asset_base_id:126dea9d-bcb8-4edb-a688-b996b4779f84) gives license cc_zero, author Introspective Mnisi, asset id cd6d0347-484a-426c-9c72-9b8c117ef500, verificationStatus validated, created 2026-09-14: saved as evidence/api-record-2026-11-18.json (SHA-256 a2df1cf19da8414f3413f4072522feee66a12c5b22785d4e54861143ca240520). BlenderKit's licensing FAQ: 'the CC0 license technically allows you to do anything with the assets' (evidence/licensing-faq-2026-11-18.html, SHA-256 c7db5b389d7e46709d6af79d8be9588a543a268099c0af56dd73c21ba4c231ff). AUTHORSHIP NOT CONFIRMED: the licence check verified CC0 on the asset's own page but could not confirm that the uploader made the mesh. The uploader is a new author on BlenderKit (the asset is from September 2026) and the mesh inside the downloaded file is named 'base.001'. BlenderKit's position on CC0 models (evidence/position-on-cc0-models-2026-11-18.html, SHA-256 a5c45685ab5a7b9dfade8a730b7ab20d0ab753d2f50fbb13050653bbb3ad4c48) asks people not to upload others' CC0 models and says it has no option yet to exclude an asset from redistribution, and an author may later change an asset's terms; the pages as retrieved are the evidence of the grant on 2026-11-18. No other source of this mesh was looked for.
